MambaSL：探索单层 Mamba 的时间序列分类MambaSL: Exploring Single-Layer Mamba for Time Series Classification

Yoo-Min Jung & Leekyung Kim
Department of Industrial Engineering, Seoul National University
pamela7384@gmail.com, klk97@snu.ac.kr
摘要Abstract

尽管最近在状态空间模型（SSM）（例如 Mamba）在各种序列域中取得了进展，但对其时间序列分类（TSC）独立能力的研究仍然有限。 我们提出了 MambaSL，一个框架，它可以最少地重新设计选择性 SSM 和投影层Despite recent advances in state space models (SSMs) such as Mamba across various sequence domains, research on their standalone capacity for time series classification (TSC) has remained limited. We propose MambaSL, a framework that minimally redesigns the selective SSM and projection layers of a单层曼巴single-layer Mamba，以四个 TSC 特定假设为指导。 为了解决基准测试限制（配置受限、部分东英吉利大学 (UEA) 数据集覆盖以及可重复性不足的设置），我们在统一协议下重新评估了所有 30 个 UEA 数据集的 20 个强基线。 因此，MambaSL 实现了最先进的性能，具有统计上显着的平均改进，同时通过所有评估模型的公共检查点确保可重复性。 这些结果与可视化相结合，展示了基于 Mamba 的架构作为 TSC 主干的潜力。, guided by four TSC-specific hypotheses. To address benchmarking limitations—restricted configurations, partial University of East Anglia (UEA) dataset coverage, and insufficiently reproducible setups—we re-evaluate 20 strong baselines across all 30 UEA datasets under a unified protocol. As a result, MambaSL achieves state-of-the-art performance with statistically significant average improvements, while ensuring reproducibility via public checkpoints for all evaluated models. Together with visualizations, these results demonstrate the potential of Mamba-based architectures as a TSC backbone.

1 简介Introduction

状态空间模型 (SSM) 已成为 Transformer 的强大替代品State space models (SSMs) have emerged as a strong alternative to Transformers(Vaswani et al., 2017)，与曼巴, with Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024; Dao and Gu, 2024)标志着语言和视频等序列领域的里程碑marking a milestone in sequence domains such as language and video(Lenz et al., 2025; Li et al., 2024)。 然而，在时间序列中，基于卷积和 Transformer 的架构仍然占主导地位，前者在时间序列分类（TSC）方面表现出色，后者在时间序列预测（TSF）方面表现出色. In time series, however, convolutional- and Transformer-based architectures still dominate, with the former excelling in time series classification (TSC) and the latter in time series forecasting (TSF)(Wang et al., 2024b)。 虽然早期作品如 TimeMachine. While early works such as TimeMachine(Ahamed and Cheng, 2024)和 S-曼巴and S-Mamba(Wang et al., 2025b)展示了 Mamba 在 TSF 中的承诺，但它在 TSC 中的作用仍未得到充分探索。showed Mamba’s promise in TSF, its role in TSC remains underexplored.

有两个差距激发了我们的研究。首先，Mamba 对于 TSC 的独立能力很少有调查。Two gaps motivate our study. First, the standalone capacity of Mamba for TSC has seen little investigation.Wang et al. (2024b)将 Mamba 列为最弱的 TSC 骨干，可能是由于缺乏研究而不是固有的架构限制，因为只评估了普通变体。 据我们所知，TSCMambaranked Mamba as the weakest TSC backbone, likely due to a lack of research rather than inherent architectural limitations, as only the vanilla variant was evaluated. To the best of our knowledge, TSCMamba(Ahamed and Cheng, 2025)是 TSC 唯一的后续基准测试尝试。 然而，它集成了ROCKET等特征工程技术is the only subsequent benchmarking attempt for TSC. However, its integration of feature engineering techniques such as ROCKET(Dempster et al., 2020)和CWTand CWT(Mallat, 1999)掩盖了曼巴的内在贡献。obscures Mamba’s intrinsic contribution.

第二个差距是，当前的 TSC 基准测试存在与覆盖范围、公平性和可重复性相关的三个关键问题。首先，评估通常仅限于东安格利亚大学 (UEA) 档案的一小部分As a second gap, current TSC benchmarking suffers from three critical issues related to coverage, fairness, and reproducibility. First, evaluations are often restricted to only a fraction of the University of East Anglia (UEA) archive(Bagnall et al., 2018)，忽略具有长序列或高输入维度的具有挑战性的数据集。其次，非 TSC 模型经常在没有适当重新调整的情况下被采用，这可能会低估其能力；例如，DLinear 等 TSF 模型, leaving out challenging datasets with long sequences or high input dimensionality. Second, non-TSC models are frequently adopted without proper re-tuning, which risks underestimating their capacity; for example, TSF models like DLinear(Zeng et al., 2023)和补丁TSTand PatchTST(Nie et al., 2023)已在 TSC 上下文中使用默认设置进行报告have been reported in TSC contexts using default settings(Wu et al., 2023; Luo and Wang, 2024)。最后，可重复性仍然是一个问题——例如，TS2Vec 的重新评估. Finally, reproducibility remains a concern—e.g., re-evaluations of TS2Vec(Yue et al., 2022)和 GPT4TSand GPT4TS(Zhou et al., 2023) by Eldele et al. (2024)与原始报告相比，平均准确率下降了超过 9%p。这些局限性削弱了文献中比较结论的可靠性。revealed average accuracy drops exceeding 9%p compared to their original reports. These limitations undermine the reliability of comparative conclusions in the literature.

受到这些差距的激励，我们从两个角度重新审视 Mamba 作为 TSC 的骨干。Motivated by these gaps, we revisit Mamba as a TSC backbone from two perspectives.(i) 架构：(i) Architecture:我们提出了四个特定于 TSC 的假设 (H1-H4)，它们指导选择性 SSM 组件以及输入和输出投影层的重新设计。We propose four TSC-specific hypotheses (H1–H4), which guide the redesign of selective SSM components and the input and output projection layers.(ii) 评估方案：(ii) Evaluation protocol:我们建立了一致的基准测试设置，并通过广泛的超参数扫描重新评估所有 30 个多元 UEA 数据集的强大 TSC 基线。 根据该协议，我们的We establish a consistent benchmarking setup and re-evaluate strong TSC baselines across all 30 multivariate UEA datasets with extensive hyperparameter sweeps. Under the protocol, our单层曼巴single-layer MambaTSC 框架 MambaSL 实现了最先进的性能。 我们的主要贡献是：TSC framework, MambaSL, achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our key contributions are:

  • •

    TSC 特定假设和架构改进。TSC-specific hypotheses and architectural refinements.我们提出以下四个假设（H1-H4）来解释为什么在现有 TSC 管道中简单地应用 Mamba 并没有完全发挥其潜力，并通过相应的设计调整来验证它们：We propose the following four hypotheses (H1–H4) that explain why naively applying Mamba within the existing TSC pipeline does not fully realize its potential, and validate them through corresponding design adjustments:

    1. (H1)

      缩放输入投影。Scale input projection.由于 Mamba 的输出是由门控单元调制的Since Mamba’s output is modulated by a gating unit(Hua et al., 2022; Mehta et al., 2023a)，输入上下文不足可能会成为性能瓶颈，从而为密集采样的时间序列激发更大的输入投影感受野。, insufficient input context can bottleneck performance, motivating a larger input projection receptive field for densely sampled time series.

    2. (H2)

      模块化时间（in）方差。Modularize time (in)variance.由于时间序列通常表现出接近线性的时不变行为，因此我们将 Mamba 的时间方差解耦为超参数。 更简单的配置通常表现更好，这与消融结果相矛盾As time series often exhibit near linear time-invariant behavior, we decouple time variance of Mamba as a hyperparameter. Simpler configurations often perform better, contradicting the ablation results fromGu and Dao (2024).

    3. (H3)

      删除跳过连接。Remove skip connection.在浅层网络中，跳过连接产生的性能提升最小In shallow networks, skip connections yield minimal performance gains(He et al., 2016; Ismail Fawaz et al., 2020)。 鉴于 Mamba 强大的远程记忆，我们删除了跳跃连接并仅从隐藏状态构建逻辑。. Given Mamba’s strong long-range memory, we remove skip connections and construct logits solely from hidden states.

    4. (H4)

      通过自适应池聚合。Aggregate via adaptive pooling.时间序列分类涵盖全局模式和事件驱动模式，这是传统池化无法适应的。因此，我们提出了一种多头自适应池，以特定于数据集的方式对时间特征进行加权。Time series classification spans both global and event-driven patterns, which conventional pooling cannot accommodate. We therefore propose a multi-head adaptive pooling that weights temporal features in a dataset-specific manner.

  • •

    全面且可重复的 UEA 基准测试。Comprehensive and reproducible UEA benchmarking.我们在所有 30 个 UEA 数据集上评估了 20 个模型，涵盖各种序列长度 (8-17,984)、输入维度 (2-1,345) 和样本大小 (12-25,000)。对于每个模型，我们探索大约 200 个超参数组合来选择最佳配置。值得注意的是，之前在 UEA 数据集上测试的 TSF 模型显示，仅使用超参数调整即可将平均准确度提高 3.04%p。We evaluate 20 models on all 30 UEA datasets, covering various sequence lengths (8–17,984), input dimensions (2–1,345), and sample sizes (12–25,000). For each model, we explore approximately 200 hyperparameter combinations to select the optimal configuration. Notably, TSF models previously tested on the UEA datasets showed an average accuracy improvement of 3.04%p with hyperparameter tuning alone.

  • •

    单层 Mamba 的实证验证。Empirical validation of a single-layer Mamba.我们的 MambaSL 框架在 UEA 基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，比第二好的方法高出 1.41%p。 我们通过消融研究验证我们的假设，并通过可视化突出骨干网和数据集特定的特征，从而展示了 Mamba 的内在潜力。Our MambaSL framework achieves the state-of-the-art performance across the UEA benchmark, outperforming the second-best method by 1.41%p. We demonstrate the inherent potential of Mamba by validating our hypotheses through ablation studies and highlighting backbone- and dataset-specific features through visualizations.

Section2审查 TSC 和 Mamba 的相关工作， 部分reviews related work for TSC and Mamba, section3详细介绍我们的假设和架构改进， 部分details our hypotheses and architectural refinements, section4描述我们的实验设置和实施细节， 部分describes our experimental setup and implementation details, section5呈现结果和分析， 和部分presents results and analysis, and section6该论文总结道。concludes the paper.

2 相关工作Related work

TSC 深度学习 (DL) 的最新进展可分为三个方向。 (一)Recent advances in deep learning (DL) for TSC can be grouped into three streams. (i)TSC 特定型号TSC-specific models例如 TS2Vec 定制编码器和读数直接用于分类such as TS2Vec tailor encoders and readouts directly for classification(Yue et al., 2022; Eldele et al., 2024; Wen et al., 2025)。 (二). (ii)基础模型Foundation models旨在使单个模型适应多个时间序列任务，包括 TSCaim to adapt a single model across multiple time-series tasks, including TSC(Wu et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2023; Luo and Wang, 2024; Wang et al., 2025a)。 (三). (iii)TSF 起源模型TSF-origin models经常被重新用作 TSC 特定模型和基础模型的基线are frequently repurposed as baselines for TSC-specific and foundation models(Zeng et al., 2023; Zhang and Yan, 2023; Nie et al., 2023)。 尽管评估通常依赖于 UEA 基准，但数据集子集的使用不一致以及 TSF 起源模型的单一设置评估导致基线被低估。 这凸显了 TSC 中标准化和一致的基准测试的必要性。. Although evaluations typically rely on the UEA benchmark, inconsistent use of dataset subsets and single-setting evaluations for TSF-origin models have led to underestimated baselines. This highlights the need for standardized and consistent benchmarking in TSC.

在 SSM 中，Mamba 主要是针对 TSF 进行探索的。 时间机器等变体Within SSMs, Mamba has been explored primarily for TSF. Variants such as TimeMachine(Ahamed and Cheng, 2024)和Sand S-曼巴Mamba(Wang et al., 2025b)通常构建时间混合嵌入，然后沿通道轴应用双向 Mamba 以减轻扫描顺序敏感性。 相比之下，对 TSC 的适应总体上相对较少，其中 TSCMambatypically construct temporally mixed embeddings and then apply bidirectional Mamba along the channel axis to mitigate scan-order sensitivity. By contrast, adaptations to TSC in general are comparatively scarce, with TSCMamba(Ahamed and Cheng, 2025)是唯一的变体。 在 TSF 和 TSC 中，Mamba 变体倾向于沿非时间轴（通道或频率）而不是原始时间轴更新 SSM 状态。being the only variant. Across TSF and TSC alike, Mamba variants tend to update the SSM state along non-temporal axes (channel or frequency) rather than the original time axis.

3.2 Mamba 中的时变 SSMTime-variant SSM in Mamba

在较高层面上，Mamba 可以被视为一个选择性 SSM 核心，并带有轻量级门控线性模块At a high level, Mamba can be viewed as a selective SSM core augmented with a lightweight gated linear block(Hua et al., 2022; Mehta et al., 2023a)。 接下来我们回顾选择性 SSM，澄清其组成部分并建立我们提出的方法中使用的符号（部分. We next review the selective SSM, clarifying its components and establishing the notation used in our proposed method (section3.3.2).

3.3.3 输出投影Output projection

H4：通过自适应池聚合H4: Aggregate via adaptive pooling

在 Mamba 块之后，每个时间步的特征被聚合成一个 logit 向量After the Mamba block, per-timestep features are aggregated into a logit vector𝒍{\bm{l}}。 传统的池化方法（例如平均值或最大值）平等地对待所有步骤或依赖于单个主导步骤，从而忽略了数据特定的时间重要性。 这个问题对于循环模型尤其重要，其中预测的标签可能会随着时间的推移而变化（例如，. Conventional pooling methods, such as average or max, treat all steps equally or rely on a single dominant one, thus ignoring data-specific temporal importance. This issue is particularly critical for recurrent models, where the predicted label may shift over time (e.g., a手写Handwriting序列标记sequence labeledgg最初可能类似于类may initially resemble classaa在稍后与before later aligning withgg).

我们提出了一种具有可学习门的多头自适应池（图We propose a multi-head adaptive pooling with learnable gates (Figure3）。 具体来说，). Specifically,NhN_{h}每个独立的门控头都会产生一个标量分数independent gating heads each produce a scalar scoregt,hg_{t,h}对于时间步长for time steptt:

gt,h=𝒘h⊤​𝒇t+bh,h=1,…,Nh.g_{t,h}={\bm{w}}_{h}^{\top}{\bm{f}}_{t}+b_{h},\quad h=1,\dots,N_{h}. (13)

对于每个For eachtt，选择跨头的最大门值并通过 softmax 进行归一化以获得每个时间步的权重, the maximum gate value across heads is selected and normalized via softmax to obtain per-timestep weightαt\alpha_{t}, 然后将其应用于每个时间步的 logit 向量, which is then applied to the per-timestep logit vector𝒍t{\bm{l}}_{t}:

gt=maxh⁡gt,h,αt=exp⁡(gt)∑i=1Lexp⁡(gi),𝒍=∑t=1Lαt​𝒍t.g_{t}=\max_{h}g_{t,h},\qquad\alpha_{t}=\frac{\exp(g_{t})}{\sum_{i=1}^{L}\exp(g_{i})},\qquad{\bm{l}}=\sum_{t=1}^{L}\alpha_{t}{\bm{l}}_{t}. (14)

这个公式概括了传统的池化： 制服This formulation generalizes conventional pooling: uniformαt\alpha_{t}恢复平均， 当急剧达到顶峰时recovers averaging, while a sharply peakedαt\alpha_{t}近似最大池化。 与注意力池相比approximates max pooling. Compared to attention pooling(Bahdanau et al., 2016)，我们的设计轻巧但富有表现力： 多头门控探索多种模式， 而自适应最大池化则选择最有信心的信号，从而实现稳健的数据集特定聚合。, our design is lightweight yet expressive: multi-head gating explores diverse patterns, while adaptive max pooling selects the most confident signals, enabling robust dataset-specific aggregation.

4 实验Experiment

我们在完整的 UEA 基准测试上进行实验We conduct experiments on the full UEA benchmark(Bagnall et al., 2018)，涵盖不同的序列长度、输入维度和样本大小。 为了简洁起见，我们将在下文中通过其代码来引用每个数据集（例如，, covering diverse sequence lengths, input dimensions, and sample sizes. For conciseness, we will hereafter refer to each dataset by its code (e.g.,EC乙醇浓度；见表for EthanolConcentration; see Table4）。 为了确保公平性，我们在统一协议下为每个模型数据集分配相同的搜索预算，为每个数据集选择最佳配置。 附录中提供了环境、数据集和指标的详细描述). To ensure fairness, we allocate an identical search budget per model–dataset under a unified protocol, selecting the best configuration for each dataset. 基线Baselines我们包括 (1) 非深度学习方法： 基于DTW的最近邻We include (1) non-DL methods: DTW-based nearest neighbor(DTWD\text{DTW}_{D}; Berndt and Clifford, 1994), 火箭, ROCKET(Dempster et al., 2020), 蜂巢2.0, HIVE-COTE 2.0(HC2; Middlehurst et al., 2021), 九头蛇, Hydra(Dempster et al., 2023), 多火箭, MultiRocket(MR; Tan et al., 2022)+九头蛇； (2) 基于MLP的模型： DL线性+Hydra; (2) MLP-based models: DLinear(Zeng et al., 2023), 光TS, LightTS(Zhang et al., 2022), MTS-混合器, MTS-Mixer(Li et al., 2023); (3) 基于CNN的模型： 时代网; (3) CNN-based models: TimesNet(Wu et al., 2023), 现代TCN, ModernTCN(Luo and Wang, 2024), 特斯拉网, TSLANet(Eldele et al., 2024), 时间混合器++, TimeMixer++(Wang et al., 2025a); (4) 基于Transformer的模型： 美联储前任; (4) Transformer-based models: FEDformer(Zhou et al., 2022), 教育考试服务中心, ETSformer(Woo et al., 2022), 交叉变形器, Crossformer(Zhang and Yan, 2023), 补丁TST, PatchTST(Nie et al., 2023), GPT4TS (Zhou et al., 2023), 智能变压器, iTransformer(Liu et al., 2024); (5)基于形状的模型： 间质GN; (5) shape-based model: InterpGN(Wen et al., 2025); (6) 基于 Mamba 的模型： TSCMamba; and (6) Mamba-based model: TSCMamba(Ahamed and Cheng, 2025).

We therefore compared our results with prior reports (appendixC.3）。 我们的评估产生了比之前报告的结果更高的性能（ModernTCN 和 TimeMixer++ 除外）。 然而，当应用报告的结果时，他们的平均排名会下降，这证实了我们的协议在所有基线上的公平性和严格性。 对于 ModernTCN，虽然平均准确度低于预期，但与重新审视的研究相比，我们通过更少的超参数试验获得了更高的准确度). Our evaluation yielded higher performance than previously reported results, except for ModernTCN and TimeMixer++. However, their average ranks decline when the reported results are applied, confirming the fairness and rigor of our protocol across all baselines. For ModernTCN, although the average accuracy was lower than expected, we achieved higher accuracy with fewer hyperparameter trials compared to the revisited study(Akacik and Hoogendoorn, 2025)。 值得注意的是，TSF 起源模型（DLinear、LightTS、MTS-Mixer、FEDformer、ETSformer、Crossformer、PatchTST 和 iTransformer）改进了超过 3%p，这表明可以针对 TSC 重新考虑它们的方法。. Notably, TSF-origin models (DLinear, LightTS, MTS-Mixer, FEDformer, ETSformer, Crossformer, PatchTST, and iTransformer) improved by over 3%p, suggesting that their methodologies can be reconsidered for TSC.

This suggests that for fixed-length datasets, fully connected readouts can be competitive as long as overfitting is controlled. 模型深度的影响Effect of model depth

虽然我们的主要架构使用单个 Mamba 块，如图所示Although our main architecture uses a single Mamba block as shown in Figure2，我们还减少了堆叠块的数量，以检查更深的 MambaSL 是否会进一步提高性能。 表, we also ablated the number of stacked blocks to examine whether a deeper MambaSL further improves performance. Table3在相同的训练协议下比较具有 1、2 和 3 个 Mamba 块的变体（完整结果在附录中提供）compares variants with 1, 2, and 3 Mamba blocks under the same training protocol (full results are provided in appendixC.5）。 我们观察到，单个层在 30 个 UEA 数据集中实现了最佳平均准确度和最佳平均排名。 虽然性能随着层数的增加而逐渐下降，但差异很小，并且所有三个变体的总体性能相似。 鉴于这些结果，我们得出结论，精心配置的). We observed that a single layer achieved the best average accuracy and the best average rank across the 30 UEA datasets. While performance gradually decreases as the number of layers increases, the differences are small, and all three variants perform similarly overall. Given these results, we conclude that a carefully configured单层single-layer在这种情况下，Mamba 足以作为 TSC 的骨干，我们采用 1 层 MambaSL 作为默认架构，以实现简单性和效率。Mamba is sufficient as a backbone for TSC in this regime, and we adopt the 1-layer MambaSL as our default architecture for both simplicity and efficiency.

For comparison, we selected the top three high-performing models from each source—HC2(Middlehurst et al., 2021), 硼酸, BORF(Spinnato et al., 2024)，以及我们自己的实验——形成一组可比较的经典基线。 这些结果以及相应的评估表在附录中提供, and our own experiments—to form a comparable set of classical baselines. 最近特定领域数据集的分类Classification on recent domain-specific dataset

尽管UEA档案馆Although the UEA archive(Bagnall et al., 2018)涵盖广泛的 TSC 数据集，但不包括最近发布的真实世界基准。 因此，我们在 ADFTD 上额外评估了 MambaSLcovers a broad range of TSC datasets, it does not include more recently released real-world benchmarks. Therefore, we additionally evaluated MambaSL on ADFTD(Miltiadous et al., 2023)和FLAAPand FLAAP(Kumar and Suresh, 2022)，Medformer 基准测试的两个最新数据集, two of the most recent datasets benchmarked by Medformer(Wang et al., 2024a)分别在医学和人类活动识别（HAR）领域。 附录中提供了与 Medformer 中强基线相比的分类结果in the medical and human activity recognition (HAR) domains, respectively. Classification results compared with strong baselines in Medformer are provided in appendixC.7。 在这两个数据集上，MambaSL 在没有任何特定领域修改的情况下实现了有竞争力的性能，证明了其对最近 TSC 任务的通用性。. Across both datasets, MambaSL achieves competitive performance without any domain-specific modifications, demonstrating its generalizability to recent TSC tasks.

6 结论Conclusion

在这项研究中，我们引入了四个假设，解释为什么曼巴蛇尽管在其他序列领域取得了成功，但在 TSC 中仍未得到充分研究。 通过最小的架构修改，我们的In this study, we introduce four hypotheses as to why Mamba has remained underexplored in TSC despite its success in other sequence domains. With minimal architectural modifications, our单层曼巴single-layer Mamba框架 MambaSL 在整个 UEA 基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。 通过重新检查 20 个先前基线，我们进一步强调了骨干结构之间的系统差异，并证明 Mamba 可以作为强大的多元 TSC 骨干。framework, MambaSL, achieved state-of-the-art performance across the entire UEA benchmark. By re-examining 20 prior baselines, we further highlighted systematic differences across backbone structures and demonstrated that Mamba can serve as a strong multivariate TSC backbone.

然而，我们的工作有两个主要局限性。 首先，虽然我们的模型在 UEA 基准测试中非常稳健，但它很少在单个数据集上取得压倒性的优势，这意味着实际使用可能需要针对特定​​领域的调整。 例如，输入嵌入的先验知识可能会限制内核大小，从而使得序列长度的感受野缩放在某些领域中不是最佳的。 二、我们的研究仅限于Mamba的第一个版本Nevertheless, our work has two main limitations. First, while our model is robust across the UEA benchmark, it rarely achieves overwhelming superiority on individual datasets, implying that practical use may require domain-specific adaptations. For instance, prior knowledge of input embedding may constrain kernel size, making receptive-field scaling with sequence length suboptimal in certain domains. Second, our study is limited to the first version of Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024)。 而曼巴-2. While Mamba-2(Dao and Gu, 2024)引入了高效的并行 Mamba 块，应用时变模块化需要低级优化，超出了本研究的范围。introduces an efficient parallel Mamba block, applying time-variance modularization requires low-level optimizations beyond the scope of this study.

总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，精心配置的单层 Mamba 可以作为 TSC 的竞争支柱。 除了 TSC 之外，未来的工作可能会通过利用感受野缩放和时间方差控制来进一步改进 Mamba， 以及浅层的、与任务一致的架构选择和自适应聚合策略。Overall, our findings demonstrate that a carefully configured single-layer Mamba can serve as a competitive backbone for TSC. Beyond TSC, future work may further improve Mamba by leveraging receptive-field scaling and time-variance control, along with shallow, task-aligned architectural choices and adaptive aggregation strategies.

附录AAppendix A实验装置Experimental setup

环境Environment

所有实验均在Python 3.12.8和PyTorch 2.5.1中实现。 大多数在 NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti (11GB) 上运行，而由于内存限制，少数需要在 Google Colab 上运行 NVIDIA A100 (40GB)。 经典基线使用All experiments were implemented in Python 3.12.8 and PyTorch 2.5.1. Most were run on NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti (11GB), while a few required NVIDIA A100 (40GB) on Google Colab due to memory limits. Classical baselines used the永旺aeon工具包toolkit(Middlehurst et al., 2024)，并且除 TSLANet 之外的所有深度模型都被集成到时间序列库中（, and all deep models except TSLANet were integrated into the Time-Series Library (TS库TSLib) (Wu et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024b)。 对于支持的型号. For models supported inTS库TSLib，我们使用了提供的代码；对于其他人，我们调整了作者的官方实现。 所有源代码都可以在我们的 GitHub 存储库中找到（请参阅, we used the provided code; for others, we adapted the authors’ official implementations. All source code is available in our GitHub repository (seereproducibility statement).

数据集Dataset

东英吉利大学档案馆The UEA archive(Bagnall et al., 2018)提供 30 个多元 TSC 数据集，具有不同的样本大小、输入维度、长度和类计数（表provides 30 multivariate TSC datasets with diverse sample sizes, input dimensions, lengths, and class counts (Table4）。 作为). AsTS库TSLib已成为广泛使用的框架，10 个数据集的子集（has become a widely used framework, a subset of 10 datasets (EC, FD, HW, HB, JV, 质子交换膜EMSPEMS, SRS1, SR2SRS2, 萨德SAD, 和, andUW）在最近的 TSC 基准测试实践中常用。) is commonly used in recent TSC benchmarking practices.

指标Metrics

我们的图表中报告的评估指标总结如下：The evaluation metrics reported in our figures and tables are summarized as follows:

  • •

    平均。帐户：avg. acc:所有 UEA 数据集的平均准确度 (%)。Average accuracy (%) across all UEA datasets.

  • •

    平均。 ACC（10）：avg. acc (10):遵循先前的 TSC 实践，10 个 UEA 数据集的平均准确度 (%)。Average accuracy (%) for 10 UEA datasets, following prior TSC practices.

  • •

    平均。排名：avg. rank:所有 UEA 数据集中每个模型的平均排名。Average rank of each model across all UEA datasets.

  • •

    # 顶部-# of top-NN:每个模型位于顶部的数据集计数Count of datasets in which each model is in top-NN.

  • •

    获胜/平局次数：# of win/draw:所提出的模型达到更高或相同精度的数据集的计数。Count of datasets where proposed model achieved higher or the same accuracy.

  • •

    输/平局数：# of loss/draw:所提出的模型达到较低或相同精度的数据集的计数。Count of datasets where proposed model achieved lower or the same accuracy.

  • •

    等级测试：rank test: pp- Wilcoxon 符号秩检验的值-value of Wilcoxon signed-rank test(Wilcoxon, 1945)。小于显着性水平 (0.05) 的值表示提出的模型排名高于所选模型。. A value smaller than the significance level (0.05) indicates that proposed model ranked greater than the selected.

B.1 基本超参数设置Basic hyperparameter settings

我们标准化了所有模型的实验超参数设置，以专注于模型调整，其中大多数被选为先前 UEA 基准测试的通用值，We standardized experimental hyperparameter settings across all models to focus on model tuning, where most were chosen as common values across prior UEA benchmarks andTS库TSLib:

    批量大小Batch size：16   （一些实验使用较小的批量大小，如附录中所述: 16   (some experiments used smaller batch size as described in appendixC.1.)

  • •

    学习率调度器Learning rate scheduler：无: none

  • •

    优化器Optimizer：拉达姆: RAdam(Liu et al., 2020)

尽管这种统一设置可能会偏离特定于模型的默认设置，但广泛的模型级网格搜索弥补了潜在的性能下降（请参阅附录Although this unified setting may deviate from model-specific defaults, extensive model-level grid searches compensated for potential performance degradation (see appendixC.3).

B.2 网格搜索的模型超参数设置Model hyperparameter settings for grid search

我们主要考虑了原始论文或源代码脚本中测试的超参数设置，并且我们还参考了中设置的超参数We primarily considered the hyperparameter settings that were tested in either the original papers or the source code scripts, and we also referred to the hyperparameters that were set inTS库TSLib脚本。 对于不提供分类脚本的 TSF 起源和基础模型，我们倾向于选择与预测脚本中相同或更小的值，因为我们根据经验发现，与 TSF 数据集相比，许多 UEA 数据集需要紧凑的模型大小。 每个模型-数据集对评估了 200 多个候选设置，但一些不需要显着扩展的模型除外。 探索的超参数如下：scripts. For TSF-origin and foundation models that do not provide classification scripts, we tend to choose the same or smaller values than in forecasting scripts since we empirically found that many UEA datasets require compact model sizes compared to TSF datasets. C.3 与之前报告的结果比较Comparison with previously reported results

尽管我们将各种超参数设置与原始论文进行了比较，以确保尽可能公平的比较，但由于基本超参数设置的一些差异（例如将学习率固定为 0.001），我们的结果可能无法代表原始论文中的结果。 因此，我们将我们的结果与之前报告的结果进行了比较，结果列于表中Although we compared various hyperparameter settings against the original paper to ensure as fair a comparison as possible, our results may not represent those in the original paper due to some differences in basic hyperparameter settings (e.g. fixing the learning rate to 0.001). Therefore, we compared our results with previously reported results, and the results are presented in Table8.

在基线模型中，仅使用直接评估分类结果的论文并在表中提及。 如果多篇论文报告了特定模型-数据集对的结果，则使用最高值进行比较。 对于 Hydra 和 MR+Hydra，BORF 中报告的结果Among the baseline models, only papers that directly evaluated the classification results are used and mentioned in the table. If multiple papers reported results for a particular model–dataset pair, the highest value was used for comparison. For Hydra and MR+Hydra, the results reported in BORF(Spinnato et al., 2024)被使用。 请注意，我们使用测试样本的数量来近似报告的值，因为它们通常四舍五入到小数点后一位或两位。were used. Note that we approximated the reported values using the number of test samples since they were typically rounded to one or two decimal places.

表中使用的指标The metrics used in Table8如下：are as follows:

C.5 根据模型深度的 MambaSL 性能完整结果Full results of MambaSL performance according to model depth

表Table10给出了对应表的完整对比结果presents the complete comparison results corresponding to Table3。 尽管使用三层在通常评估的 10 个数据集上产生了最高的平均准确度. Although using three layers yielded the highest average accuracy on the 10 datasets commonly evaluated inTS库TSLib，当扩展到完整的 30 个 UEA 数据集时，该观察结果不成立。 在检查这 10 个数据集的平均排名时，我们发现单层配置始终优于多层变体，这表明更深层次模型的较高平均精度是由一小部分数据集驱动的。 特别是，, this observation does not hold when extended to the full set of 30 UEA datasets. When examining the average rank on these 10 datasets, we find that the single-layer configuration consistently outperforms the multi-layer variants, indicating that the higher average accuracy for deeper models is driven by a small subset of datasets. In particular, theHW与单层相比，2-3 层的数据集表现出近 5%p 的改进，这对平均准确度指标产生了不成比例的影响。dataset exhibits a nearly 5%p improvement with 2–3 layers compared to a single layer, which disproportionately affects the average accuracy metric.

C.6 InceptionTime设置下UEA基准的分类结果Classification results on the UEA benchmark under InceptionTime setting

为了解决提出的数据泄露问题To address the data-leakage concern raised forTS库TSLib，我们在 InceptionTime 协议下训练 MambaSL，该协议选择训练损失最低的检查点, we trained MambaSL under the InceptionTime protocol, which selects the checkpoint with the lowest training loss(Ismail Fawaz et al., 2020)。 为了进行比较，我们从每个来源中选择了前三个高性能模型 — HC2. For comparison, we selected the top three high-performing models from each source—HC2(Middlehurst et al., 2021), 硼酸, BORF(Spinnato et al., 2024)，以及我们自己的实验——形成具有代表性的传统 TSC 基线集。 对于 HC2，我们仅使用第 0 折的结果，即官方训练-测试分割, and our own experiments—to form a representative conventional TSC baseline set. For HC2, we used only the results from fold 0, the official train–test split333完整的报告结果集可在The full set of reported results is available attimeseriesclassification.com., 对于 BORF，我们使用附录中所述的测试样本数量来近似报告的准确度, and for BORF, we approximated the reported accuracies using the number of test samples as described in appendixC.3.

表Table11总结了结果。 尽管 MambaSL 的平均准确率略低于 HC2 和 Hydra，但它仍然具有竞争力，获得了最多数量的 top-1 结果（15 个数据集），并且在直接的头对头比较中优于每个非 DL 基线。 这些发现表明 MambaSL 在无泄漏模型选择下保持了强劲的性能。summarizes the results. Although MambaSL achieved slightly lower average accuracy than HC2 and Hydra, it remained competitive, achieving the largest number of top-1 results (15 datasets) and outperforming every non-DL baseline in direct head-to-head comparisons. These findings indicate that MambaSL maintains strong performance under leakage-free model selection.

由于所有实验超参数和优化设置都固定为与我们原始实验中相同的值，因此表之间的性能差异Since all experimental hyperparameters and optimization settings were fixed to the same values as in our original experiments, the performance differences between Tables5和and11仅由模型选择标准的变化引起。arise solely from the change in the model selection criterion.

我们在重新评估表中的某些非 DL 基线时观察到更高的性能The higher performance observed in our re-evaluation of certain non-DL baselines in Table11源于运行三个随机种子并报告表现最好的运行。 仅使用单个种子（种子 0）产生的结果与最初报道的 HC2 和 BORF 的结果相当。stems from running three random seeds and reporting the best-performing run. Using only a single seed (seed 0) yields results comparable to those originally reported for HC2 and BORF.

为了进一步评估稳定性，我们对 MambaSL 进行了两项额外的试验，并在表中报告了三项试验的平均值和标准差To further assess stability, we conducted two additional trials for MambaSL and report the mean and standard deviation across three trials in Table12.

与表相反In contrast to Table11，其中 HC2 和 Hydra 基于表现最佳的试验显示出最强的性能，对所有试验进行平均表明 MR+Hydra 实现了最强的平均性能并表现出更一致的结果。 尽管如此，MambaSL 仍然具有竞争力，在直接的头对头比较中优于所有传统的非 DL 基线，并实现了最多数量的 top-1 结果（13 个数据集）。 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验表明 MambaSL 和 MR+Hydra 之间没有显着差异，表明该协议下的整体有效性相当。, where HC2 and Hydra showed the strongest performance based on the best-performing trial, averaging across all trials indicates that MR+Hydra achieves the strongest mean performance and exhibits more consistent results. Nevertheless, MambaSL remains competitive, outperforming all conventional non-DL baselines in direct head-to-head comparisons and achieving the largest number of top-1 results (13 datasets). The Wilcoxon signed-rank test indicates no significant difference between MambaSL and MR+Hydra, suggesting comparable overall effectiveness under this protocol.

C.7 ADFTD 和 FLAAP 的分类结果Classification results on ADFTD and FLAAP

虽然 UEA 档案为多元 TSC 提供了标准化基准，但它主要由 1999 年至 2018 年间发布的数据集组成，其中许多数据相对干净且规模较小While the UEA archive provides a standardized benchmark for multivariate TSC, it mainly consists of datasets released between 1999 and 2018, many of which are relatively clean and small in scale(Bagnall et al., 2018)。 为了评估我们模型在这些设置之外的稳健性，我们还在两个更新的特定领域的 TSC 数据集上测试了 MambaSL。. To evaluate the robustness of our model beyond these settings, we additionally tested MambaSL on two more recent and domain-specific TSC datasets.

遵循 Medformer 的评估方案Following the evaluation protocol of Medformer(Wang et al., 2024a)，我们选择ADFTD, we selected ADFTD(Miltiadous et al., 2023)来自医学领域和FLAAPfrom the medical domain and FLAAP(Kumar and Suresh, 2022)来自人类活动识别（HAR）领域。 表中提供了两个数据集的摘要from the human activity recognition (HAR) domain. A summary of both datasets is provided in Table13.

预处理和实验设置与官方 Medformer 实施保持一致。 我们首先使用 UEA 实验中使用的 240 个超参数配置来评估 MambaSL，之后我们对一些性能最佳的配置进行了四次额外的试验，总共运行了五次。 表Preprocessing and experimental settings were aligned with the official Medformer implementation. We first evaluated MambaSL using the 240 hyperparameter configurations employed for the UEA experiments, after which we conducted four additional trials on some best-performing configurations, resulting in a total of five runs. Table14报告这些试验的平均准确度和 F1 分数。 为了进行比较，我们还纳入了 Medformer 报告的表现出色的基线结果reports the average accuracy and F1-score across these trials. For comparison, we also include the results of the strongly performing baselines reported by Medformer(Wang et al., 2024a)： 交叉变形者: Crossformer(Zhang and Yan, 2023), 塑身机, Reformer(Kitaev et al., 2020), 变压器, Transformer(Vaswani et al., 2017), TCN (Bai et al., 2018), 现代TCN, ModernTCN(Luo and Wang, 2024)和曼巴, and Mamba(Gu and Dao, 2024)。 由于原始 Medformer 论文没有报告 TCN、ModernTCN 和 Mamba 在 ADFTD 上的结果，因此这些条目留空。. Since the original Medformer paper did not report results for TCN, ModernTCN, and Mamba on ADFTD, these entries are left blank.

如表所示As shown in Table14，MambaSL 在两个数据集上的表现都与之前的基线相比具有竞争力，并且在 FLAAP 上实现了最高的准确率。 特别是，我们观察到比香草曼巴 (vanilla Mamba) 提高了 10% 以上。 总而言之，ADFTD 和 FLAAP 的结果表明，MambaSL 在跨领域和数据集规模上保持稳定，这表明其性能并不局限于 UEA 存档的特征。, MambaSL performed competitively against previous baselines on both datasets, and achieved the highest accuracy on FLAAP. In particular, we observe more than a 10%p improvement over the vanilla Mamba. Taken together, the results on ADFTD and FLAAP show that MambaSL remains stable across domains and dataset scales, reinforcing that its performance is not limited to the characteristics of the UEA archive.
